```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

```

AvrStb6 gene expression

Violin + Box plot (TPM) 

```{r}

df <- read.csv("AvrStb6_TPM_Obelisk.csv")

selected_dpi <- c("4", "8", "12","16","20")

df <- df %>% 
  filter(dpi %in% selected_dpi)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(dpi = factor(dpi, levels = c("4", "8", "12","16","20")))

df$dpi <- factor(df$dpi, levels = c(4,8,12,16,20))

ggplot(df, aes(x = dpi, y = tpm, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15), size = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("in planta" = "#1b9e77"),
    name = "Treatment"  # <-- updated legend title
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "AvrStb6 gene expression (TPM)",
    x = "Days post-inoculation (dpi)",
    y = "TPM"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )


# Save last plot as a high-resolution PNG
ggsave("Obelisk_AvrStb6_gene_expression.png", width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 600)


```
